2226-4576-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4576-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Fleetfoot Panther by paying its mana cost.
When Fleetfoot Panther enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

240-969-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-969-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2645-3430-4644-4717.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4644-4717.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3220-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3220-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

6553-7424-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2073-2511-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-2511-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

129-1409-2079-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5231-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5231-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1267-2292-4034.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-2292-4034.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

4802-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-3185-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2921-3185-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

972-3542-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-3542-7487.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is an artifact.
When the Palinchron token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Zealous Lorecaster by paying its mana cost.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster and the Palinchron token.
When the Zealous Lorecaster and Palinchron tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-3542-7487.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Palinchron and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Zealous Lorecaster instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

4681-5147-5170-7452.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

7-1824-2530-7360.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
7-1824-2530-7360.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-1824-2530-7360.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
God-Pharaoh's Faithful triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

1379-1606-6871.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

2366-4974-5702-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4974-5702-6791.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

57-4846-6657-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6657-6791.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

876-944-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

2173-2511-2932-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2511-2932-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2173-2511-2932-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1661-4549-5051-5078.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Traxos, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

338-3197-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-5789.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

104-4186-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-4716.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

513-527-647.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-647.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2187-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2187-2493-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Possessed Skaab.
When Archaeomancer and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-2493-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2608-4188-4499.notablePrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist does not have summoning sickness. You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
2608-4188-4499.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist's second ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV<=3 that has "When ~ enters, you get at least {E}"

678-997-5674--40.description:
Cast the creature that causes you to get energy counter(s) when it enters the battlefield by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When the creature enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get at least {E}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2060-3525-5296-5462.manaNeeded: {7} available plus an additional {1} if you have no colored mana
2060-3525-5296-5462.notablePrerequisites: Raucous Entertainer does not have summoning sickness.
2060-3525-5296-5462.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, using at least one colored mana if available.
If Crystalline Crawler has a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Raucous Entertainer by paying {1} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler, Workhorse and any other creature you control the entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Raucous Entertainer.
Repeat from step 5.

147-3331-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
147-3331-4050-5220.description:
Cast Thunderous Debut by paying {6}{G}{G} and sacrificing an artifact, enchantment or token.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Thunderous Debut.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dualcaster Mage on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the copy of Thunderous Debut, causing you to look at the top twenty cards of your library and put Dualcaster Mage and up to one other creature card onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1355-2024.notablePrerequisites:
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five enchantments.
1355-2024.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, untapping Sanctum Weaver and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1424-2034-3767.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Scuttling Sliver.
Scuttling Sliver does not have summoning sickness.
1424-2034-3767.description:
Activate Scuttling Sliver by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scuttling Sliver by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
